svg.title: Processes, and the nodes inside them
svg.desc: Each large box is one operating-system process. A component container is a process that hosts several ROS nodes; each row inside it is one node, with its role. Example: the Pecos QA sandbox.

g.text: What the process list shows while the QA sandbox runs: three component containers and a few single processes. Grouping nodes into one process changes nothing about how they talk; it only

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: saves resources. Nodes communicate over topics and services, which this view leaves out.
